source_file: Compute new columns with expressions and functions.sas
notes: DATA step on sashelp.cars filtered to Origin=Europe: computes KmH_Highway/KmH_City via MPG*1.609344, KmH_Average via mean(), applies a 4.1 format to all KmH: columns, keeps with a colon selector, then PROC PRINT. Shipped byte-identical; autoexec only sets options obs=100.
